testcase.name: success checks actual returned values and closes all resources
close failure cannot masquerade as disconnected success
TLS connection failure never reports success or retries
cancel invokes driver cancel and close and reports unknown without retry
late cancellation cannot overwrite a terminal result
type corruption must fail instead of reporting success
closed runner rejects new work and destroys supplied credentials
cancel and cleanup close once and wait for actual close completion
